title: BigScience: A Case Study in the Social Construction of a Multilingual Large Language Model
reasoning: The paper presents a case study where the development of the LLM was explicitly guided by a 'value-driven' approach and an 'ethical charter'. It dedicates substantial sections to discussing moral values, normative ethics frameworks (such as value pluralism), and philosophical traditions (specifically Confucian moral theory) as foundational components of the model's social construction and organizational governance.
